goal.raw_text: Record voucher distribution transaction with auto-generated invoice

claims.content: VMU User
Distributor master must exist or be creatable (system allows quick navigation to master screen to enter new Distributor details without closing present screen).
Sales Man master must exist or be creatable (system allows quick navigation to master screen to enter new Salesman details without closing present screen).
Voucher stock must be available for allocation based on distributor’s required quantity.
System must support auto-generation of Distribution Invoice No.
System must support automatic calculation of Invoice Amount = Whole Sale Rate * Qty Sold, with rate taken from settings master based on sale date.
System must allow selection of Date of Distribution via date selection option.
System must enforce numeric-only entry for Required Qty (No of vouchers sold).
The VMU User initiates a distribution transaction by entering mandatory information including distributor name, sales man name, date of distribution, and required quantity of vouchers.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates a distribution transaction by entering mandatory information including distributor name, sales man name, date of distribution, and required quantity of vouchers.

claims.content: The VMU User selects the Name of the distributor from Distributor Master.
The VMU User selects the Name of the Sales Man from Sales man master.
The VMU User selects the Date of Distribution using the date selection option.
The VMU User enters the Required Qty (No of vouchers sold), allowing only numeric entry.
The system automatically calculates Invoice Amount = Whole Sale Rate (taken from settings master based on sale date) * Qty Sold.
The system generates an auto-generated number as Distribution Invoice No.
While entering the No of vouchers required, the system automatically picks the Batch No’s with voucher No’s from the available voucher stock and lists the details of each voucher in grid format.
A Distribution Invoice No. is auto-generated by the system.
Relevant vouchers with their numbers and batch numbers are allocated from stock based on the number of vouchers required by the distributor.
The details of each allocated voucher (including Batch No’s and voucher No’s) are listed in a grid format.
The invoice amount is calculated and recorded as: No of vouchers x Wholesale price (or Whole Sale Rate * Qty Sold).
The mode of payment for the transaction is recorded as Cash.
Sales details are captured and available for reporting by Distributor-wise, Salesman-wise, and Batch No wise.
